findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: person, routines, routine, page, posts, alerts, draft · Private data: page_cards, my_games, my_game_numbers, track, alerts, follow, connect_game · Public sink: genres, my_game_numbers, my_game_days, routines, routine, draft · Destructive: person, track, routines, routine.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: person, routines, routine, page, posts, alerts, draft · Private data: page_cards, my_games, my_game_numbers, track, alerts, follow, connect_game · Public sink: genres, my_game_numbers, my_game_days, routines, routine, draft · Destructive: person, track, routines, routine

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
